name: Exact Carpet Inventory Link Fix
notes: Locks Carpet Cutting to the exact Carpet Inventory record selected by the operator. Persists carpetRecordId from Carpet Inventory through drafts, saved operations, completion, stock deduction and Cutting History; completion resolves by ID first and exact roll number second, preventing sourceRoll/parentRoll child records from receiving the deduction. Build051 cut-count persistence, Build050 Full Roll Finish, Add Work validation, Private Administrator access and Multi-AI Gateway are retained.
